BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was bio-engineered in an embryo synthesis bench and gestated within an industrial growth vat. [PAWN_pronoun] has known only sterile acceleration pods, biometric calibration, and neural programming.

BackstoryDef.title: construct
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] functions as a mass-produced biological construct. Free from emotional sentimentality, social friction, and personal ambition, [PAWN_pronoun] exists solely to execute assigned directives as colony property.
